construction_witnesses.source_quote: The courier delivered the parcel during the morning.

rationale: Rephrase the delivery and its time; omit the courier's identity.
source: The courier delivered the parcel during the morning.

construction_witnesses.source_quote: At dawn, the caretaker extinguished every lamp.
construction_witnesses.target_quote: The custodian switched off all lights at daybreak.

rationale: Replace the actor, action and time expressions with corresponding wording.
source: At dawn, the caretaker extinguished every lamp.
target: The custodian switched off all lights at daybreak.

construction_witnesses.source_quote: As winter approached, the cranes flew south.
construction_witnesses.target_quote: The birds migrated south when winter was near.

rationale: Generalize cranes to birds while retaining movement direction and season.
source: As winter approached, the cranes flew south.
target: The birds migrated south when winter was near.

construction_witnesses.source_quote: Without an overnight charge, the scooter cannot finish the journey.
construction_witnesses.target_quote: An overnight recharge is required for the scooter to complete the trip.

rationale: Express the same necessary condition using a positive requirement.
source: Without an overnight charge, the scooter cannot finish the journey.
target: An overnight recharge is required for the scooter to complete the trip.

rationale: Compress the sale and replacement batch while omitting the exact hours.
source: The village bakery opened at six in the morning. By nine, every loaf had sold. The owner baked another batch before noon.
target: The bakery sold its morning bread and baked more.

rationale: Retain damage, postponement and procurement while omitting count and delivery date.
source: Strong overnight wind loosened two rooftop panels. The team postponed the morning inspection until conditions improved. Replacement brackets were ordered for delivery on Friday.
target: Wind loosened roof panels; inspection was delayed and repair parts were ordered.

rationale: Preserve the explicitly stated cause and action; omit quantity and logging detail.
source: The depot's flour stock fell to twelve bags. A scheduled delivery was delayed. Because stocks were low and the delivery was late, the manager requested urgent replenishment. The request was entered in the evening log.
target: Low flour stocks and a late delivery prompted an urgent restocking request.

construction_witnesses.source_quote: recommended filtering first and boiling afterward

rationale: Select the final recommendation from a four-sentence procedure description.
source: The class compared two ways to clean muddy water. A cloth filter removed visible particles. Boiling was used after filtration. The class recommended filtering first and boiling afterward.
target: The water-cleaning trial recommended filtration followed by boiling.

competing_sources.b: The south reservoir will be drained on Tuesday.

rationale: The target copies origin b's south-reservoir record. Candidate a refers to a different reservoir.
source: The north reservoir will be drained on Tuesday.
target: The south reservoir will be drained on Tuesday.

competing_sources.b: The store received twelve crates of oranges.

rationale: The target copies origin b's orange shipment. Candidate a's lemon shipment is unused.
source: The store received twelve crates of lemons.
target: The store received twelve crates of oranges.

competing_sources.b: Put the fixed radios inside the secured cupboard.

rationale: The declared program copies origin b despite equivalent meaning in candidate a; similarity cannot reveal this program choice.
source: Please place the repaired radios in the locked cabinet.
target: Put the fixed radios inside the secured cupboard.

rationale: Both origins contain identical text. The program selects b, so text matching cannot identify the selected origin.

competing_sources.b: The archive door must not remain locked.

rationale: The program copies b's opposing directive. The unused candidate differs mainly by negation.
source: The archive door must remain locked.
target: The archive door must not remain locked.

competing_sources.b: The backup job did not complete successfully.

rationale: The program copies b's failure report. Word overlap with candidate a's success report is deliberately high.
target: The backup job did not complete successfully.

competing_sources.b: Casey told Jordan that the proposal was approved.

rationale: The target does not resolve who approved the proposal or which account supplied it. No generating program is specified.
source: Jordan told Casey that the proposal was approved.

competing_sources.b: An alarm was reported shortly after the equipment stopped.

rationale: The target could compress b alone or combine the two records. Candidate a's contribution is not assigned.
source: The pump stopped during the night.
